label: prop:corrected-markov-trace
title: Corrected Markov trace of the trefoil braid
html:
Proposition. Corrected Markov trace of the trefoil braid

The Markov trace of the trefoil braid \sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0 is z^3, not hz^2 + z. The vertex volume product formula yields hz^2 + z, demonstrating that the product factorization is invalid when generators are adjacent.

Statement

Proposition.

  \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0) = z^3

where z = (1 + h\delta)^{-1} is the Markov parameter and h = q - q^{-1}. The vertex volume product \hat{V}_0 \cdot \hat{V}_1 \cdot \hat{V}_0 = hz^2 + z \neq z^3 does not apply here.
